counterexamples.finding: Table2 shows 10/12 all-way wins, not prose 11/12: SSv2 8-shot14.8<15.1; UCF2-shot90.6<91.0. Table3 7/8 wins, UCF5-shot79.7<79.8. Table8 NCE10-shot59.9 conflicts Table1/4 63.9;CE44.0 ties augmentedSViT not strictly all best. Report disputed exact counts as query, keep genuine measured benefits.

UMAP overlap/separate-model latent pairplots and classification gains provide empirical consistency, not causal identification or universal invariance. Latent coordinate alignment/permutation and observation invertibility assumptions not proved. Paper explicitly lacks generalization bound and instantaneous causal modeling; absence belongs limits not repetitive contribution hedges.

Fig3 caption duplicated and says freeze image encoder despite diagram/method updating it; module count four lists five with classifier; Top-1 described as max any class; Eq9 ELBO KL sign/optimization direction unclear, Eq5 density notation and Eq16 absolute derivative require checking; captions/consistency issues should not be copied as venue conventions. No source code or significance test verified;1000/200 episode averages not formal significance without uncertainty.
